I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-team. I confirmed that the signed order form for Tamsin Cold Chain is due 20 November, and said I wouldn't do anything with it, since they said no action was needed.

The date is now in that channel thread, but I didn't save it anywhere else, such as a calendar entry or a memory note. It's a signing deadline, which counts as an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so posting it there didn't need approval.
